policy: Additive only. No automated same-object confirmation. Weak or visual evidence never confirms identity.

evidence.quoted_text: Images reuse the same obverse photograph but show different reverse photographs; this is an image/source anomaly, not evidence for one physical specimen.

assertions.review_note: The saved review identifies an image/source anomaly. It supplies neither explicit object-level sameness nor sufficient object-level proof of distinctness. Do not infer identity from either photograph.
